acceptance_criteria: cargo check passes; pkix_chain::DefaultVerifier resolves; verify_chain_default is callable without a verifier argument; clippy -D warnings passes.
description:
**What:** Make pkix-chain::verify_chain usable without requiring callers to construct a SignatureVerifier by providing a default RustCrypto-backed verify_chain_default() function and re-exporting DefaultVerifier from pkix-chain.

BLOCKED BY: PKIX-8wg (DefaultVerifier must exist in pkix-path), PKIX-m49 (pkix_chain::Error must exist).

**Algorithm:**
1. In pkix-chain/src/lib.rs, add re-export: pub use pkix_path::DefaultVerifier;
2. Add a convenience function:
   pub fn verify_chain_default<R>(
       chain: &[Certificate],
       anchors: &[TrustAnchor],
       policy: &ValidationPolicy,
       revocation: &R,
   ) -> Result<ValidatedPath>
   where R: RevocationChecker
   {
       verify_chain(chain, anchors, policy, &DefaultVerifier, revocation)
   }
   This function is gated: only available when pkix-path's default/rustcrypto features are active.
3. Update pkix-chain crate docs to show verify_chain_default in the quick-start example.
4. No other changes — verify_chain itself stays generic.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- verify_chain_default must not add any new error paths beyond what verify_chain already has.
- No unwrap() anywhere.
- The DefaultVerifier re-export must be feature-gated consistently with its definition in pkix-path.

**Subagent instructions:**
Single subagent. Read pkix-path/src/lib.rs to confirm DefaultVerifier's feature gate before writing the re-export and wrapper. Then implement.

**Tests:**
- test_verify_chain_default_compiles: confirm that calling verify_chain_default with a real chain, real anchors, real policy, and NoRevocation compiles without requiring a verifier argument. Oracle: compile success. NOTE: since validate_path is todo!() until PKIX-h6z, this test will panic at runtime; mark with #[ignore] until h6z is closed.
- test_default_verifier_reexport: import pkix_chain::DefaultVerifier; confirm it is the same type as pkix_path::DefaultVerifier (they are the same type). Oracle: type identity.
title: pkix-chain: wire DefaultVerifier into verify_chain and re-export
